intent: Implement every Phase 4 durable proposal and human-gated canary admission unit from a fresh main-based worktree without exposing proposal persistence, held-out fixtures, or lifecycle authority to QuickJS.
scope: origin/main merge-base through the phase-4-admission working tree

findings.title: Verifier admitted undetected export mutations
findings.fix: Reject undetected mutations, isolate each export mutation in a fresh context, install the interrupt deadline before evaluation, and bump the verifier version.

findings.title: Admission evaluator had no production worker
findings.fix: Start a dedicated admission worker with its own store connection and configured embedder alongside the bounded proposal worker.

findings.title: Approval trusted stale held-out selection
findings.fix: Rerun identity, predecessor, duplicate, held-out, verifier/fake version, and embedding compatibility gates immediately before the private canary transaction.

findings.title: Successful evaluation could strand verified proposals
findings.fix: Persist the passed report, verified revision, and awaiting-approval proposal state in one transaction.

findings.title: Proposal parsing copied arrays before enforcing bounds
findings.fix: Inspect QuickJS array and string lengths before allocating Rust values and consume the per-session attempt budget before shape parsing.

findings.title: Blocked proposals had no reevaluation transition
findings.fix: Add an authenticated optimistic transition that requeues only held-out-suite-blocked proposals after trusted suite import.

findings.title: Idempotent enqueue could rebind lineage
findings.fix: Reject same-artifact submissions that name a different immutable predecessor.

findings.title: Long evaluation could outlive its lease
findings.fix: Renew the claimed lease to a bounded evaluation window and cap aggregate matched suites and cases.

findings.title: Proposal capability was hidden from tool discovery
findings.fix: Advertise the structured propose_skill global only when its durable workers are installed.

findings.title: Evaluation reports were not rehashed on read
findings.fix: Centralize the versioned report identity, bind timestamps, validate it before persistence, and rehash reports on every review read.

advisory_outputs: Phase 3 entry dependencies are delivered and their beads are closed.
No relevant docs/solutions learning was found.
Canary stays intentionally absent from active retrieval, prompt manifests, turn bundles, and runtime source binding until Phase 5.

validation.real_binary_smoke: passed: headless Hello and TUI Ready to code
